description: Enforce an armed background watcher while lobstah work is in flight; the watcher wakes the session on completion. The blocking park remains available with man haul --park. The Stop hook is inert unless the directory opts in with .lobstah-man (or LOBSTAH_MAN=1) or the session is soaking. SessionStart announces the session id; SessionEnd stows a soaking session cleanly.
